sources.title: Hippocampal 'Time Cells' Bridge the Gap in Memory for Discontiguous Events
sources.authors: MacDonald CJ, Lepage KQ, Eden UT, Eichenbaum H
sources.role: foundational — first systematic description of hippocampal time cells in CA1

sources.title: Time Cells in the Hippocampus: A New Dimension for Mapping Memories
sources.role: primary review — framework for cognitive map extended to time dimension

sources.title: Memory on Time
sources.role: review — temporal context theory and sequential memory

sources.title: Time Cells in Hippocampal Area CA3
sources.authors: Salz DM, Tiganj Z, Khasnabish S, Kohley A, Sheehan D, Howard MW, Eichenbaum H
sources.role: original research — extends time cells to CA3; temporal precision decreases over time in CA3

sources.title: Medial Entorhinal Cortex Selectively Supports Temporal Coding by Hippocampal Neurons
sources.authors: Robinson NTM, Priestley JB, Rueckemann JW, Garcia AD, Smeglin VA, Marino FA, Eichenbaum H
sources.role: original research — mEC inactivation disrupts CA1 temporal coding selectively (contested)

sources.title: Time Cells in Hippocampal Area CA1 Are Neither Dependent on Medial Entorhinal Cortex Inputs nor Necessary for Spatial Working Memory
sources.authors: Sabariego M, Schönwald A, Boublil BL, Zimmerman DT, et al.
sources.role: original research — mEC lesion does NOT reduce CA1 time cells (contradicts Robinson 2017)

sources.title: Evidence for a Subcircuit in Medial Entorhinal Cortex Representing Elapsed Time during Immobility
sources.role: original research — mEC has time-encoding neurons during immobility (distinct subcircuit from grid cells)

sources.title: Contextual and Pure Time Coding for Self and Other in the Hippocampus
sources.authors: Omer DB, Las L, Ulanovsky N
sources.role: original research — two populations: contextual time cells vs pure time cells; social temporal coding

sources.title: Human Hippocampal and Entorhinal Neurons Encode the Temporal Structure of Experience
sources.authors: Tacikowski P, Kalender G, Ciliberti D, Fried I
sources.role: original research — direct single-neuron recording in human hippocampus/EC; temporal structure encoding + replay

sources.title: Sequential Firing Codes for Time in Rodent Medial Prefrontal Cortex
sources.authors: Tiganj Z, Jung MW, Kim J, Howard MW
sources.role: original research — mPFC has time cells with properties similar to hippocampal time cells

sources.title: What Makes Us Tick? Functional and Neural Mechanisms of Interval Timing
sources.role: landmark review — interval timing: striatal beat frequency model, DA dependence, Parkinson's

sources.title: A Neural Mechanism for Sensing and Reproducing a Time Interval
sources.role: original research — parietal cortex ramping signal slope encodes time interval

sources.title: Different Contributions of Preparatory Activity in the Basal Ganglia and Cerebellum for Self-Timing
sources.authors: Kunimatsu J, Suzuki TW, Ohmae S, Tanaka M
sources.full_text_note: 未读取全文；eLife 通常开放获取，但本次未验证 PMC 状态
sources.role: original research — basal ganglia tracks time throughout delay; cerebellum adjusts at end
